svg.desc: New Cotton Gins LOCATION Zagazig - Kafr Elzayat - Kafr Eldawar, Egypt CLIENT Cotton and Textile Holding Company COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2020 EGP 500 million DISCIPLINES Landscape Design Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Detailed design, coordination & construction supervision for 3 new cotton gins hangars. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered landscape design, architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
